plan.notes: Official UW-Madison Guide 2026-2027 Computer Sciences BS four-year plan (Total Credits 120 as published). The four-year plan is advisory ('only one way a student may complete'); major requirements verified on the program page: 39+ advanced CS/Math credits incl. COMP SCI/MATH 240, COMP SCI/E C E 252, COMP SCI 300, COMP SCI/E C E 354, COMP SCI 400 (15 basic), Linear Algebra (one of MATH 320/340/345/341/375), Probability/Statistics (one of listed STAT/MATH), Theory (COMP SCI 577 or 520), 6-8 Software/Hardware, 3 Applications, 6-8 electives. 3-4 credit choice slots recorded at minimum 3 credits per convention (COMP SCI 577 = 3 credits). Breadth slots are generic placeholders for the published L&S BS breadth requirements.
